person.persName: حسين الأكبر بن عطية بن محمد بن محمد بن أبي الخير محمد بن فهد الهاشمي المكي

birth.note: He died before completing one month of age, meaning he was born in 849 AH.

death.note: He died in Rabīʿ al-Ākhir 849 AH, at less than one month of age. His date of death was chronicled by his cousin.

relation.note: The brother Ḥasan b. ʿAṭiyya b. Muḥammad b. Muḥammad b. Abī al-Khayr has his own entry (AIND-D02561).

person.note: フサイン・アル＝アクバル・ビン・アティッヤ・ビン・ムハンマド・ビン・ムハンマド・ビン・アビール＝ハイル・ムハンマド・ビン・ファハド・アル＝ハーシミー・アル＝マッキー。ハサンの兄弟。849年ラビーウ・アル＝アーヒルにマッカで没した。1ヶ月に満たなかった。彼の従兄弟がその死を記録した。

Ḥusayn al-Akbar, the son of ʿAṭiyya, the son of Muḥammad, the son of Muḥammad, the son of Abī al-Khayr Muḥammad, the son of Fahd, al-Hāshimī al-Makkī. He was the brother of Ḥasan. He died in Rabīʿ al-Ākhir in the year 849 AH in Mecca, not having completed a month of age. His cousin chronicled his date of death.
